memories.textContent:
Woke up with the sun in my eyes today
Gonna have the best little kind of day
Tiny paws are tapping on the bathroom floor
Ready to go see what the world has in store
Little furry cheeks and a button nose
Following the smell where the good food goes
Climbing up the ladder to the kitchen high
Watching all the birds in the bright blue sky
I smell something cooking and it smells so sweet
Gonna get a bowl of a savory treat
The sun is shining down and the water is hot
Everything is perfect in this little spot
Slurping up the noodles on a sunny day
Eating ramen making all my worries go away
Little hamster happy with a great big bowl
Warming up my belly and it warms my soul
Slurp, slurp, slurp, oh it tastes so good
Finest little lunch in the neighborhood
With a noodle in my cheek and a smile so wide
Got that sunny feeling living deep inside
Twirling round and round like a little spinning wheel
That is exactly how this ramen makes me feel
Broth on my whiskers and a noodle in my hand
I am the luckiest little guy in all the land
The sun keeps shining through the window on the floor
Don't think I could ever ask for anything more
Just a little hamster and a big warm bowl
That is how I like to let the good times roll
I smell something cooking and it smells so sweet
Gonna get a bowl of a savory treat
The sun is shining down and the water is hot
Everything is perfect in this little spot
Slurping up the noodles on a sunny day
Eating ramen making all my worries go away
Little hamster happy with a great big bowl
Warming up my belly and it warms my soul
Slurp, slurp, slurp, oh it tastes so good
Finest little lunch in the neighborhood
With a noodle in my cheek and a smile so wide
Got that sunny feeling living deep inside
Just a little hamster on a sunny day
Bye bye for now gotta finish my bowl
Yum yum yum yum warms up my soul
